notes: The two-floor fixture prefixes copied node identities and retains separate parent/content state.
The frame-choice path uses replace-resource on board nodes only when the information sample shares the current company identity, so child content remains in the document.
Bitmap ownership checks retain an external cloned instance before cache eviction and dispose that instance explicitly before asserting the final close.
Finish lifetime checks use a separate ceiling layout and retain scene image clones before cache eviction.
The standalone package test edits the pinned save, reloads it through the package viewer, then restarts the browser context and compares the full document.

runtime_limits: No browser or GPU run was performed by this review.

The CPU geometry script defers decoding the two PNG-bearing content GLBs because Node lacks the browser image decoder. The current browser content-asset parse correction remains producer-owned and is not counted as a runtime pass here.
The library catalog and production output may be changing during integration. This report does not claim fixed-build or final source/asset identity.
No new information-specific lifecycle defect was found in the inspected ownership wiring. Existing ImageBitmap close coverage is owned by the separate lifecycle review.
